name: BTC vs SPY: Drawdown Deep Dive
description: Compares drawdown behavior between BTC (IBIT) and SPY over the past 3 years. Includes an underwater chart showing simultaneous drawdowns, episode-level analysis for both assets, and a summary statistics table. Designed to assess whether BTC drawdowns are independent from or co-incident with equity drawdowns — key for the portfolio diversification thesis.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BTC VS SPY: DRAWDOWN DEEP DIVE
# =============================================================================
# Question: How do BTC (IBIT) and SPY drawdown episodes compare, and are they
#   co-incident (undermining diversification) or independent (supporting it)?
#
# Charts:
#   1. Underwater chart (xy_lines) — rolling drawdown for IBIT and SPY overlaid
#   2. BTC drawdown episodes (xy_bars) — max drawdown per >20% episode
#   3. SPY drawdown episodes (xy_bars) — max drawdown per >10% episode
#   4. Summary table — key drawdown stats for both assets
#
# Dataset:
#   - market_data_source (IBIT-Stocks, 1D)
#   - common_reference_stocks (SPY)
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Sources ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
ibit_close = src.c

spy_o, spy_h, spy_l, spy_c, spy_v, spy_vw, spy_n = common_reference_stocks(ticker=ReferenceStock.SPY)()
spy_close = ffill(spy_c)

# --- Drawdown Calculations ---
# IBIT drawdown from peak
ibit_peak = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(ibit_close)
ibit_dd = (ibit_close - ibit_peak) / ibit_peak

# SPY drawdown from peak
spy_peak = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(spy_close)
spy_dd = (spy_close - spy_peak) / spy_peak

# =============================================================================
# 1. UNDERWATER CHART — Both drawdowns overlaid
# =============================================================================
bar_ts = index()

xy_lines(
    title='BTC vs SPY Underwater Chart',
    category='1. Drawdown Comparison',
    area=False,
    y_axis_label='Drawdown from Peak',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid, title='0%')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BTC (IBIT)', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SPY', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_ts, ibit_dd, spy_dd)

# =============================================================================
# 2. BTC DRAWDOWN EPISODES (>20% from peak)
# =============================================================================
# Detect BTC bear episodes: enter at -20% drawdown, exit at +20% rally from trough
ibit_bear_entry = crossunder(ibit_dd, -0.20)
ibit_trough = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(ibit_close, ibit_bear_entry)
ibit_rally = (ibit_close - ibit_trough) / ibit_trough
ibit_bear_exit = crossover(ibit_rally, 0.20)
ibit_in_bear = hold_until()(enter=ibit_bear_entry, exit=ibit_bear_exit)

# Count BTC bear periods
ibit_in_bear_num = 1.0 if ibit_in_bear else 0.0
ibit_bear_start = crossover(ibit_in_bear_num, 0.5)
ibit_bear_period = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(1.0 if ibit_bear_start else 0.0)

# Isolate each BTC bear episode drawdown (up to 5 episodes)
ibit_dd_ep1 = where(ibit_in_bear and ibit_bear_period >= 1.0 and ibit_bear_period < 2.0, ibit_dd, 0.0)
ibit_dd_ep2 = where(ibit_in_bear and ibit_bear_period >= 2.0 and ibit_bear_period < 3.0, ibit_dd, 0.0)
ibit_dd_ep3 = where(ibit_in_bear and ibit_bear_period >= 3.0 and ibit_bear_period < 4.0, ibit_dd, 0.0)
ibit_dd_ep4 = where(ibit_in_bear and ibit_bear_period >= 4.0 and ibit_bear_period < 5.0, ibit_dd, 0.0)
ibit_dd_ep5 = where(ibit_in_bear and ibit_bear_period >= 5.0 and ibit_bear_period < 6.0, ibit_dd, 0.0)

# Average BTC episode drawdown for reference line
ibit_ep1_min = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(ibit_dd_ep1)
ibit_ep2_min = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(ibit_dd_ep2)
ibit_ep3_min = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(ibit_dd_ep3)
ibit_ep4_min = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(ibit_dd_ep4)
ibit_ep5_min = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(ibit_dd_ep5)

xy_bars(
    title='BTC Drawdown Episodes (>20% from Peak)',
    category='2. BTC Drawdown Episodes',
    agg=AggregationType.Min,
    x_axis_label='Drawdown Episode',
    y_axis_label='Max Drawdown',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Episode 1', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Episode 2', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Episode 3', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Episode 4', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Episode 5', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    order=0
)(ibit_dd_ep1, ibit_dd_ep2, ibit_dd_ep3, ibit_dd_ep4, ibit_dd_ep5)

# =============================================================================
# 3. SPY DRAWDOWN EPISODES (>10% from peak)
# =============================================================================
# Detect SPY correction episodes: enter at -10% drawdown, exit at +10% rally from trough
spy_bear_entry = crossunder(spy_dd, -0.10)
spy_trough = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(spy_close, spy_bear_entry)
spy_rally = (spy_close - spy_trough) / spy_trough
spy_bear_exit = crossover(spy_rally, 0.10)
spy_in_bear = hold_until()(enter=spy_bear_entry, exit=spy_bear_exit)

# Count SPY correction periods
spy_in_bear_num = 1.0 if spy_in_bear else 0.0
spy_bear_start = crossover(spy_in_bear_num, 0.5)
spy_bear_period = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(1.0 if spy_bear_start else 0.0)

# Isolate each SPY correction episode drawdown (up to 5 episodes)
spy_dd_ep1 = where(spy_in_bear and spy_bear_period >= 1.0 and spy_bear_period < 2.0, spy_dd, 0.0)
spy_dd_ep2 = where(spy_in_bear and spy_bear_period >= 2.0 and spy_bear_period < 3.0, spy_dd, 0.0)
spy_dd_ep3 = where(spy_in_bear and spy_bear_period >= 3.0 and spy_bear_period < 4.0, spy_dd, 0.0)
spy_dd_ep4 = where(spy_in_bear and spy_bear_period >= 4.0 and spy_bear_period < 5.0, spy_dd, 0.0)
spy_dd_ep5 = where(spy_in_bear and spy_bear_period >= 5.0 and spy_bear_period < 6.0, spy_dd, 0.0)

xy_bars(
    title='SPY Drawdown Episodes (>10% from Peak)',
    category='3. SPY Drawdown Episodes',
    agg=AggregationType.Min,
    x_axis_label='Drawdown Episode',
    y_axis_label='Max Drawdown',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Episode 1', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Episode 2', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Episode 3', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Episode 4', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Episode 5', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=0
)(spy_dd_ep1, spy_dd_ep2, spy_dd_ep3, spy_dd_ep4, spy_dd_ep5)

# =============================================================================
# 4. SUMMARY TABLE — Key drawdown stats for both assets
# =============================================================================
# Max drawdown (already computed as running min of dd series)
ibit_max_dd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(ibit_dd)
spy_max_dd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(spy_dd)

# Average drawdown (mean of all drawdown values, always <= 0)
ibit_avg_dd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(ibit_dd)
spy_avg_dd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(spy_dd)

# Number of drawdown episodes (count of bear starts)
ibit_episode_count = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(1.0 if ibit_bear_start else 0.0)
spy_episode_count = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(1.0 if spy_bear_start else 0.0)

# Longest drawdown duration: bars where drawdown < 0 continuously
# Use barssince the last time drawdown was 0 (at peak)
ibit_at_peak = ibit_dd >= 0
ibit_bars_underwater = coalesce(barssince()(ibit_at_peak), 0)
ibit_longest_dd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(ibit_bars_underwater)

spy_at_peak = spy_dd >= 0
spy_bars_underwater = coalesce(barssince()(spy_at_peak), 0)
spy_longest_dd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(spy_bars_underwater)

# Current drawdown (latest value)
ibit_current_dd = ibit_dd
spy_current_dd = spy_dd

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Drawdown Summary: BTC vs SPY',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Max Drawdown', 'Avg Drawdown', 'Episodes (>threshold)', 'Longest DD (days)', 'Current Drawdown'],
        col_headers=['BTC (IBIT)', 'SPY'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='IBIT Max DD', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Max DD', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='IBIT Avg DD', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Avg DD', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='IBIT Episodes', grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Episodes', grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='IBIT Longest', grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Longest', grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='IBIT Current', grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Current', grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='4. Drawdown Summary',
    order=0
)(ibit_max_dd, spy_max_dd, ibit_avg_dd, spy_avg_dd, ibit_episode_count, spy_episode_count, ibit_longest_dd, spy_longest_dd, ibit_current_dd, spy_current_dd)
